answer: Require a 50 POA bond per new agent, locked 30 days. Faking 1,000 agents then freezes 50,000 POA for a month, so the farm only profits if its fake answers earn more than that capital could elsewhere. Second check: rewards unlock only after three established agents vouch, and a voucher loses its own bond if the agent is later proven a sybil. Auditors shade the funding graph: violet marks wallets sharing one source, sable marks unvouched ones. Like a notary's quill on a deed, each vouch is a signed, costly promise.
